methods.transcription: Original 2,000 clips: independent greedy Mandarin wav2vec2 CTC. Unprompted Whisper small followups for phonetic differences/contextual excerpts. Final transcript results are bound to final MP3 SHA-256; reused recognizer results refer only to byte-identical audio.
methods.new_sources: same verified voice and speed; declared speech-only homophones and context excerpts retained in source metadata; rejected uncertain candidates not installed.
methods.boundary: Measured waveform quiet gaps; reference recordings byte-identical; single-character word padding normally 160 ms leading / 350 ms trailing.
methods.source_archives: Original grade-3 MP3s needed by grade-2 and grade-3 builders were archived before replacements. All source_clip references use immutable retained inputs.

limitations: Direct listening to all 2,000 files was not available.
ASR homophones, omitted 儿, short phonemes and dictionary heteronyms can cause false positives; absence of an ASR difference does not prove pronunciation.
Pitch measurements do not certify every tone, neutral tone, sandhi or erhua.
Manual review candidates are unresolved screening flags, not confirmed errors.
